content: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to dapsone or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary, as dapsone can pass into breast milk. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Benzoyl peroxide is a commonly used acne treatment. However, using benzoyl peroxide simultaneously with dapsone gel may cause temporary discoloration of the skin (yellow or orange). If someone overdoses on this medication and exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Certain cosmetics and soaps may exacerbate acne, but moisturizers are generally safe to use. When purchasing cosmetics, moisturizers, or other skincare products, look for labels that say non-comedogenic or non-acnegenic, as these are less likely to worsen acne. Consult your doctor or pharmacist to determine which products are safe for you. Remember, acne is not caused by dirt. If you miss a dose of this medication, apply it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature and do not freeze it. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Side effects such as skin redness, peeling, oiliness, or dryness may occur. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. If you experience side effects, contact your doctor for medical advice.
